newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares ease in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares ease in light trade.

text.p: Estonian shares ended lower on Monday after a brief bull-run last week but dealers expected the market to pick up again ahead of six-month results.
Total trade on the main list was 32.8 million kroons with the Talse 0.89 percent lower at 276.24.
"Today's market was sleepy with no buyers around and the prices just fell," one trader said.
Other dealers said that last week's climb during the brief three-day week may have been a bit too fast and that today's session witnessed a slight correction.
But the overall outlook was not bearish.
"Some banks may release their results later this week and no one is expecting bad news," a trader said.
Forekspank was the most active stock on turnover of 15.2 million kroons to lose 0.75 kroons for a close of 194.75 kroons.
Hansapank closed at 147.00 kroons, down 1.50 kroons after turning over 5.2 million kroons.
The free market was dominated by trade in privatisation vouchers with volume of 6.8 million kroons.
Interest in vouchers was sparked by offers in Estonian Gas and the Hotel Olumpia.
The vouchers closed up at 0.325 kroons up from 0.316 kroons.
